provider.title: Tides Plus
provider.description: Which tide data source do you want to use? Pick the region that covers the station you want to add. Each provider fetches from its own public API — no accounts needed.

search.title: Tides Plus — {provider}
search.description: Enter a location to find nearby tide stations — a place name like "Bridgeport, CT" or "Scheveningen", a US ZIP code, or a native station ID to skip the picker. Leave blank to use your Home Assistant home location.

error.unknown_station: That station ID was not found at the selected data source.
error.unknown_provider: That data source is not registered.
error.not_tidal: That station exists but does not publish tide predictions.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the tide data source. Try again in a moment.
error.geocode_failed: Could not find a place matching that search. Try a ZIP code or "City, ST".
error.no_home_location: Home Assistant has no home coordinates set. Enter a location or set your home in Settings → System → General.
